map_structure_on_dataset: map a function over all DataArrays in an xarray Dataset and merge results back
map_structure_on_dict: recursively map a function over nested dicts containing xarray DataArrays
map_structure_on_list: map a function over a list or tuple of xarray structures element-wise
map_structure_on_leaf: apply a function directly to a single xarray DataArray leaf node
map_structure_multi_structure: map a function across multiple parallel structures like two Datasets at once
